# release-guardian

*Gate the release. Then gate the claims about it.*

> 用同一套纪律卡住发布，也卡住关于这次发布的说法。

[![CI](https://github.com/LucisZhang/release-guardian/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LucisZhang/release-guardian/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

## Why this exists · 为什么做

`release-guardian` is a private LangGraph agent that reviews a proposed software
change — a destructive schema migration, an API field removal, an authentication
change — retrieves evidence in parallel, grades release risk with floors applied in
code rather than left to the model, and stops at a human approval interrupt before
anything is published. This repository is that agent's sanitized public face: not
the private repository, not a live model, and not a reproduction of the full
workflow. What is published is built around separated evidence classes, hash-pinned
assets, retained residuals, and a verifier that fails CI when a published number
drifts from its recorded hash or loses its caveat — not a headline highlight reel.

> `release-guardian` 是一个私有 LangGraph agent：接收一次待评审的变更（破坏性 schema 迁移、API 字段下线、认证改动），并行拉取证据，用写死在代码里的 risk floor 而不是模型判断来定级，并在发布任何东西之前停在人工审批 interrupt 上。本仓库只是它的脱敏公开面：既不是私有仓库，也不是 live model，更不是完整流程的复现。这里发布的东西围绕证据类别隔离、资产哈希锁定、residual 保留，以及一个会在数字与记录哈希对不上、或 caveat 丢失时直接让 CI 失败的校验器——不是精选战绩。

## Quickstart · 快速开始

Requires Node.js 24 or newer. <!-- src: package.json --> There are no runtime
dependencies, no API key, no GPU, and no model call anywhere in this repository;
nothing here contacts the private repository, a model API, or any network service.

> 需要 Node.js 24 及以上。仓库没有 runtime dependency、没有 API key、不用 GPU，也不存在任何 model 调用；下面这些命令不会连私有仓库、model API 或任何网络服务。

dependencies, no API key, no GPU, and no model call anywhere in this repository;
nothing here contacts the private repository, a model API, or any network service.

> 需要 Node.js 24 及以上。仓库没有 runtime dependency、没有 API key、不用 GPU，也不存在任何 model 调用；下面这些命令不会连私有仓库、model API 或任何网络服务。

```bash
npm ci
npm test                         # 4 tests over the scoring policy, incl. fail-closed cases
npm run verify:evidence          # re-hashes every evidence asset against the manifest
npm run replay -- SYN-SCHEMA-02  # score the destructive schema-migration scenario
```

The last command prints exactly:

> 最后一条命令的输出是固定的：

```json
{
  "scenario_id": "SYN-SCHEMA-02",
  "score": 90,
  "level": "critical",
  "blockers": [
    "rollback not tested",
    "monitoring gap",
    "missing evidence: Tested restore procedure",
    "missing evidence: Export failure monitor"
  ],
  "fixed_disclosure": "Sanitized deterministic replay — not connected to the private repository or a live model."
}
```

## Headline · 核心结果

**All 8 aggregate gates pass on a funded live evaluation of 132 graph runs — 44
scenarios, 3 trials each, recorded 2026-07-11 — and the same record retains
30/44 scenarios flagged in the strict all-trials outcome view plus 1 trajectory
failure.** <!-- src: evidence/data/evaluation-live.csv --> The aggregate pass and
the strict residual are published as one claim, because the aggregate pass is not a
claim that every scenario passes.

> 一次 funded live 评估共 132 次 graph run（44 个场景 × 3 trial，记录日期 2026-07-11），8 个聚合 gate 全部通过；同一份记录同时保留 strict all-trials 视角下被标记的 30/44 场景与 1 次 trajectory failure。聚合通过和 strict residual 作为同一条结论一起发布——聚合通过不等于每个场景都通过。

strict all-trials view is the column that carries that harder question.

## What shipped · 交付内容

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  intake["Change intake"] --> classify["Classify"] --> parse["Parse typed request"] --> fanout{"Parallel evidence retrieval"}
  fanout --> code["Code dependencies"]
  fanout --> schema["Schema impact"]
  fanout --> api["API contracts"]
  fanout --> ops["Runbooks and incidents"]
  code --> aggregate["Aggregate evidence"]
  schema --> aggregate
  api --> aggregate
  ops --> aggregate
  aggregate --> grade["Apply risk floor and grade"] --> plan["Build rollout and rollback plan"]
  plan --> validate["Validate schema, citations, and consistency"] --> gate["Human approval interrupt"]
  gate -->|approved| publish["Publish report artifact"]
  gate -->|rejected or needs info| hold["Hold or gather more evidence"]
  checkpoint[("Durable checkpoints")] -. resume .-> gate
  audit[("Approval audit log")] -. decision .-> gate
```

Two properties are worth noticing in the shape: risk grading happens after evidence
aggregation and applies coded risk floors, and `publish` is reachable only through
the approval gate's approved branch, with durable checkpoints letting a run wait at
the gate and resume once the decision is made. This diagram is a sanitized
description of the private agent's control flow, not an executable graph in this
repository; nothing here runs it.

## Risk policy replay · 风险策略复算

Measurement conditions first: these are fixed synthetic rule outputs. The scorer reads
four fictional scenarios with fictional components, symbols, and 2030 timestamps,
applies additive integer weights, caps the score at 100, and maps it to a band. It
calls no model, contacts no network, and does not rerun the private workflow.
<!-- src: scripts/replay.mjs, replay/synthetic-scenarios.json -->

> 先说测量条件：这些是固定的合成规则输出。scorer 读入四个虚构场景（虚构组件、虚构符号、2030 年时间戳），按整数权重相加，分数封顶 100，再映射到风险带。它不调用 model，不联网，也不会重跑私有流程。

Weights are `breaking_api` 40, `irreversible_schema` 35, `auth_boundary` 25,
`major_dependency` 20, `rollback_untested` 20, `monitoring_gap` 15, and
`missing_evidence_each` 10; bands are critical ≥ 70, high ≥ 45, medium ≥ 20, low ≥ 0.
<!-- src: replay/synthetic-scenarios.json -->

> 权重取值为 `breaking_api` 40、`irreversible_schema` 35、`auth_boundary` 25、`major_dependency` 20、`rollback_untested` 20、`monitoring_gap` 15、`missing_evidence_each` 10；风险带划分为 critical ≥ 70、high ≥ 45、medium ≥ 20、low ≥ 0。

| Scenario | Change type | Score | Band | Blockers | Verdict |
|---|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| SYN-DEP-04 | dependency upgrade | 20 | medium | 0 | no blockers |
| SYN-AUTH-01 | authentication configuration | 25 | medium | 0 | no blockers |
| SYN-API-03 | API field removal | 50 | high | 1 | consumer acknowledgement missing |
| SYN-SCHEMA-02 | database schema change | 90 | critical | 4 | untested rollback, monitoring gap |

<!-- src: replay/synthetic-scenarios.json, scripts/replay.mjs; SYN-AUTH-01 and SYN-SCHEMA-02 rows additionally asserted in tests/replay.test.mjs -->

The engine fails closed rather than degrading: an unknown scoring fact, a non-boolean

<!-- src: replay/synthetic-scenarios.json, scripts/replay.mjs; SYN-AUTH-01 and SYN-SCHEMA-02 rows additionally asserted in tests/replay.test.mjs -->

The engine fails closed rather than degrading: an unknown scoring fact, a non-boolean
fact, a missing fact, a malformed missing-evidence list, a negative weight, or a
non-monotonic band set all raise instead of scoring. 2 of the 4 tests cover
exactly those failure paths. <!-- src: scripts/replay.mjs, tests/replay.test.mjs -->

> 这个引擎是 fail-closed 而不是降级运行：出现未知 fact、非布尔 fact、缺失 fact、格式错误的 missing-evidence 列表、负权重，或者非单调的 band 设置，都会直接抛错而不是照样给分。4 个测试里有 2 个专门覆盖这些失败路径。

What this replay does not establish: it is a presentation-layer derivative classified
in its own fixture as synthetic, sanitized, and not source evidence. Matching scores
here say nothing about the private agent's accuracy, because the private agent's risk
grading is measured only by `risk_grade_accuracy` in the evaluation tables above.
Every scenario's code retriever also carries an explicit source boundary: private
paths and real symbols are withheld, so this demo cannot independently prove
private-code lineage, consumer completeness, or transitive dependency coverage.
<!-- src: replay/synthetic-scenarios.json -->

> 这段 replay 不能证明什么：它在自己的 fixture 里就被标注为 synthetic、sanitized、presentation-layer derivative、not source evidence。这里分数对得上，并不能说明私有 agent 的准确率——后者只由上面评估表里的 `risk_grade_accuracy` 衡量。每个场景的 code retriever 也都写明了 source boundary：私有路径与真实符号一律不给出，所以这个 demo 无法独立证明私有代码谱系、consumer 清单完整性或传递依赖覆盖度。

## Evidence contract · 证据契约

  <!-- src: scripts/verify-evidence.mjs -->

count, and residual counts — 8 metrics each, 30/44 live, 15/44 stub
  <!-- src: scripts/verify-evidence.mjs -->

# exactly-once-drills

[![ci](https://github.com/LucisZhang/exactly-once-drills/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LucisZhang/exactly-once-drills/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

A single-node **reliability lab** with two certified ingress paths into the same
`Flink 1.20 → Apache Iceberg v2 (upsert)` correctness boundary: preserved direct
MySQL CDC (**Path A**) and an Avro-contract, Kafka-brokered path (**Path B**).

> 单节点可靠性实验室：保留的 MySQL 直连 CDC（**Path A**）与走 Avro contract、经 Kafka 中转的（**Path B**）两条入口，最终都落到同一条 `Flink 1.20 → Apache Iceberg v2 (upsert)` 正确性边界。

![Path A and broker Path B architecture](showcase/media/phase-b1-path-a-b.svg)

## Quickstart · 快速开始

```bash
make local-verify
```

This no-Docker path runs unit tests, lint and type checks, Maven verification, and the static
dashboard build with results-contract validation. It reviews committed runs; it does not
reproduce the Flink/MySQL/Iceberg failure drills on demand.

> 这套不依赖 Docker 的检查流程会跑单测、静态检查、Maven 验证和面板构建；它只审阅已提交结果，不会现场重放故障。

A streaming demo that works on the happy path proves nothing about exactly-once delivery.
Real failures happen around task processes, checkpoints, coordinators, savepoints, and sink
commits — so this lab **induces those failures on purpose** and then asks a narrow, checkable
question: after this specific failure and recovery path, do the MySQL source snapshot, the
Iceberg table snapshot, and the changelog event-ID sets still agree, row by row? Every claim
is backed by a committed, machine-checkable JSON artifact with full provenance (`run_id`,
`git_sha`, exact command, logs).

> 顺利跑通不代表 exactly-once 成立。这里会主动注入任务崩溃、JobManager 重启和 Sink 提交故障，并演练 checkpoint/savepoint 恢复；随后逐行核对 MySQL、Iceberg 与 changelog 事件 ID，每项结论都能追到 JSON、命令和日志。

## Verified claims · 已验证结果

Claims are **gated**: a claim is added to
[`docs/resume-claims-after-verification.md`](docs/resume-claims-after-verification.md)
only after the phase that proves it has passed and produced auditable JSON under
[`showcase/results/`](showcase/results/).

> 只有阶段验收通过并产出可审计 JSON，对应结论才会进入简历声明清单。

| Claim | Proof |
| --- | --- |
| Exactly-once final-state reconciliation across **five induced failure classes** — task crash, retained-checkpoint restore, JobManager restart, savepoint restore, and a deterministic checkpoint-complete sink-commit fault — with **zero snapshot diff and consistent event-ID audits** in every class. | [`showcase/results/eo_reconciliation.json`](showcase/results/eo_reconciliation.json) (run `20260711T035242Z-b518d211`), incident log in [`RUNBOOK.md`](RUNBOOK.md) |
| CDC correctness smoke: source-vs-Iceberg final-state parity including updates and deletes, changelog audit counts, and equality-delete file metadata receipts. | [`showcase/results/phase-1.2-cdc-smoke.json`](showcase/results/phase-1.2-cdc-smoke.json) |
| Iceberg small-file maintenance: `rewrite_data_files` + manifest rewrite compacted **48 data files to 2**, cut planned scan tasks 48 → 2, raised median file size 2,809 → 6,614.5 bytes, and lowered measured `planFiles()` latency 54.92 ms → 44.57 ms across seven repetitions. | [`showcase/results/iceberg_small_file_rewrite.json`](showcase/results/iceberg_small_file_rewrite.json), chart in [`showcase/media/`](showcase/media/) |
| Checkpoint behavior under load: real Prometheus-reporter metrics show max checkpoint duration rising **55 ms → 19,022 ms** under a deterministic input spike, max alignment time ~5 ms → 16,882 ms, one recorded checkpoint failure, backpressure appearing, and Iceberg commit lag growing to **320 events and recovering to zero**. | [`showcase/results/checkpoint_metrics.json`](showcase/results/checkpoint_metrics.json), chart in [`showcase/media/`](showcase/media/) |

## Delivery-semantics chain · 投递语义链

| Path | Delivery-semantics chain | Meaning and proof boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **A — preserved direct CDC** | MySQL GTID/binlog → embedded Debezium in Flink CDC → Flink checkpoint/savepoint state → Iceberg v2 snapshot | No broker offset exists. The claim is final MySQL snapshot vs equality-delete-aware Iceberg snapshot reconciliation, supplemented by the changelog event-ID audit, across the five Path A drills. [`eo_reconciliation.json`](showcase/results/eo_reconciliation.json) is the proof. |
| **B — broker ingress** | MySQL GTID/binlog → standalone Debezium Connect (**at-least-once**) → Registry-backed Avro (`BACKWARD`) → Kafka partition offsets → checkpointed Flink Kafka source → Iceberg v2 keyed-upsert snapshot | Redelivery is possible before Flink, so correctness depends on primary-key keying, idempotent current-state upserts, and an audit-visible changelog. Each result links Kafka offsets ↔ a completed Flink checkpoint ↔ Iceberg snapshot IDs; parity is proved in [`broker_parity.json`](showcase/results/broker_parity.json). |

<sub>End-to-end semantics and proof boundaries · 端到端语义与验证边界</sub>

The Kafka record key is the MySQL `order_id` primary key. Kafka therefore preserves order for
one key inside its assigned topic partition; it does **not** provide total order across keys or
partitions. The controlled mis-key drill proved that a wrong Kafka key crosses that boundary and
must be rejected before main-topic admission
([result](showcase/results/ordering_miskey_drill.json)).

> Kafka 只保证同一 key 在分区内有序；key 配错后，这项顺序保证就不再成立，所以 mis-key 记录必须在进入主 topic 前被拒绝。

consumption; the committed B1 parity artifact remains an immutable record of the earlier

The upgrade failed in useful, preserved ways before certification: the first assigned host was a

## Engineering tradeoffs · 工程实战与取舍

The upgrade failed in useful, preserved ways before certification: the first assigned host was a
[restricted container without Docker or the required capabilities](showcase/logs/phase-b1-remote-preflight-blocked.log),
then [Docker Hub timed out during image resolution](showcase/logs/phase-b1-broker-up-20260820T094359Z.log).
The Avro cutover exposed both a [missing Python Avro dependency](showcase/logs/phase-b2-broker-verify-20260820T112758Z.log)
and a [terminal Flink job before baseline convergence](showcase/logs/phase-b2-broker-verify-20260820T114149Z.log);
the certified run records the resulting Jackson/Avro pins
([B2 result](showcase/results/schema_contract_drill.json)). A reconnect-style rerun also
relaunched completed parity work until the append-only fence stopped it
([failure log](showcase/logs/phase-b1-broker-verify-20260820T102412Z.log)), which led to completed-run
reuse in the tmux wrapper. On the final dedicated VM, the project measured the fixed B4 workload
and five recovery paths ([B4 result](showcase/results/broker_slo.json)); the tradeoff is explicit:
single-node Kafka KRaft and at-least-once Debezium are accepted for a reproducible lab, while
keyed idempotence, reconciliation, and preserved failed-run artifacts carry the correctness story—not
HA claims. The measured memory envelope and locked component choices are in the
[ADR](docs/adr-001-broker-cdc-registry.md).

> 认证前先后遇到受限主机、Docker Hub 超时、Avro 依赖缺失、Flink 提前失败和重复启动。修复后，单节点 Kafka KRaft 与 at-least-once Debezium 仍是刻意保留的取舍；正确性靠主键幂等、对账和失败记录来验证，不借 HA 叙事拔高。

- **Correctness-safe reading.** Iceberg v2 upsert tables contain equality deletes; pyiceberg

## Verification model · 验证方式

- **Correctness-safe reading.** Iceberg v2 upsert tables contain equality deletes; pyiceberg
  is not a correctness reader for them. The lab splits the paths: `make sql-iceberg` reads
  data through **Flink SQL batch**; `make sql-iceberg-meta` uses pyiceberg for **metadata
  only** (files, manifests, snapshots).

> - **正确性读取路径。** Iceberg v2 的 upsert 表里存在 equality delete，pyiceberg 不能作为它的正确性读取器。因此本实验把两条路径拆开：`make sql-iceberg` 通过 **Flink SQL batch** 读数据；`make sql-iceberg-meta` 只用 pyiceberg 读 **metadata**（files、manifests、snapshots）。

- **Results contract.** Every artifact must carry `run_id`, `git_sha`, `started_at`,
  `finished_at`, `stack_versions`, `command`, and `logs`
  ([contract](showcase/results/README.md)); the dashboard sync step validates this before an
  artifact is publishable.

> - **结果契约。** 每份产物都必须带上 `run_id`、`git_sha`、`started_at`、`finished_at`、`stack_versions`、`command` 和 `logs`（[契约](showcase/results/README.md)）；面板同步步骤会先校验这些字段，产物才允许发布。

- **Incident log.** [`RUNBOOK.md`](RUNBOOK.md) records each induced failure as an incident:
  trigger, observed symptom, detection/recovery commands, validation, artifact links.

> - **事故日志。** [`RUNBOOK.md`](RUNBOOK.md) 把每一次注入的故障按事故记录：触发方式、观察到的现象、检测与恢复命令、验证过程、产物链接。

def parse_failure_classes(raw: str) -> list[str]:
    requested = [item.strip() for item in raw.split(",") if item.strip()]
    if not requested:
        raise ValueError("--failure must name at least one failure class")
    if requested == ["all"]:
        return list(SUPPORTED_FAILURES)

    unknown = sorted(set(requested) - set(SUPPORTED_FAILURES))
    if unknown:
        supported = ", ".join([*SUPPORTED_FAILURES, "all"])
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported failure class(es): {', '.join(unknown)}; use {supported}")
    return requested

def _payload(*, results: list[dict[str, Any]], errors: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    passed_results = [result for result in results if result.get("passed") is True]
    all_snapshot_diffs_zero = len(passed_results) == len(results) and all(
        result.get("snapshot_diff_count") == 0 for result in passed_results
    )
    all_event_id_audits_consistent = len(passed_results) == len(results) and all(
        bool(result.get("event_id_audit", {}).get("consistent")) for result in passed_results
    )
    return {
        "phase": "2.1",
        "reader": "Flink SQL batch",
        "claim_boundary": "MySQL CDC -> Flink -> Iceberg",
        "results": results,
        "summary": {
            "passed": not errors,
            "failure_classes": [str(result.get("failure_class")) for result in results],
            "all_snapshot_diffs_zero": all_snapshot_diffs_zero,
            "all_event_id_audits_consistent": all_event_id_audits_consistent,

    }

# rag-quality-lab

*Measure the change, not the demo.*

> RAG 改动到底是变好还是变差，先量出来再说。

[![CI](https://github.com/LucisZhang/rag-quality-lab/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LucisZhang/rag-quality-lab/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

## Why this exists · 为什么做

`rag-quality-lab` is a single-machine evaluation harness that answers one question about a
Retrieval-Augmented Generation change: did answer quality improve, or did it silently get
worse. It ships two comparable pipelines, a five-metric judged evaluator with deterministic
retrieval diagnostics, a version-to-version regression differ, manifest-verified datasets, and
a model-free CI lane. Every table below is bound to a committed artifact, carries its own
evidence date, and keeps the blocked and failed runs in place — the judged scores were
re-parsed in 2026-07, not re-judged, and the runs that did not complete are recorded as
receipts rather than removed.

> 这个仓库是一台机器上就能跑完的 RAG 评测工具链，只回答一个问题：某次改动让答案质量变好了还是悄悄变差了。里面有两条可对比的 pipeline、一个带 retrieval 诊断指标的五指标 judged evaluator、版本间的 regression diff、带 manifest 校验的数据集，以及一条完全不调模型的 CI。下面每张表都绑定到仓库里的具体文件，标注证据日期；judged 分数在 2026-07 只做了重新解析，没有重新评判，跑不通的实验也以 receipt 形式保留，没有清掉。

## Quickstart · 快速开始

The verification chain below runs from a fresh clone with no model, no GPU, no API key, and no
paid call. It installs only lint, test, and data-verification dependencies — no torch, no
chromadb, no Ollama client — and never contacts Ollama, a Hugging Face model host, or any
inference endpoint. Network access is used for `pip install` only.

> 下面这条验证链在全新 clone 上就能跑：不需要模型、GPU、API key，也没有任何付费调用。依赖只装 lint、测试和数据校验相关的包，不装 torch、chromadb、Ollama client，运行期间不会连 Ollama、Hugging Face 或任何推理服务；除了 `pip install`，全程不联网。

```bash
python3.11 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements-ci.txt
ruff check .
pytest
python scripts/verify_data.py
python scripts/ci/run_verify_a3_deterministic.py
```

`scripts/verify_data.py` re-checks every present data file against the SHA-256, byte size, and
record count in `data/MANIFEST.json` and exits non-zero on any mismatch.
`scripts/ci/run_verify_a3_deterministic.py` re-parses the saved result artifacts and re-derives
the headline counts and means. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs exactly these four commands on
pushes to `main` and on pull requests.

> `scripts/verify_data.py` 会把现存的每个数据文件和 `data/MANIFEST.json` 里的 SHA-256、字节数、记录数逐项比对，任一不符即非零退出；`scripts/ci/run_verify_a3_deterministic.py` 重新解析已保存的结果产物，把核心的计数和均值重新算一遍。`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 在推送 `main` 和提 pull request 时跑的就是上面这四条命令，没有别的。

The judged pipelines themselves are a separate, heavier path: they need
`requirements-lock-py311.txt`, a local Ollama with `gemma4:e4b` and `nomic-embed-text`, and a
first-run download of `cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2`. That path is not part of the
verification chain above.

def normalize_doc_ids(doc_ids: Any) -> list[str]:
    """Normalize doc ids to a unique, ordered list of non-empty strings."""
    if doc_ids is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(doc_ids, str):
        stripped = doc_ids.strip()
        return [stripped] if stripped else []
    if not isinstance(doc_ids, list):
        values = [str(doc_ids).strip()]
    else:
        values = [str(item).strip() for item in doc_ids]

    normalized: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for value in values:
        if not value or value in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(value)
        normalized.append(value)
    return normalized


def compute_retrieval_metrics(
    retrieved_doc_ids: list[str],
    relevant_doc_ids: list[str],
) -> dict[str, float]:

    relevant = normalize_doc_ids(relevant_doc_ids)
    relevant_set = set(relevant)

"""Compute deterministic document-level retrieval diagnostics."""

    relevant_set = set(relevant)
    matched = [doc_id for doc_id in retrieved if doc_id in relevant_set]

    precision = len(matched) / len(retrieved) if retrieved else 0.0
    recall = len(matched) / len(relevant) if relevant else 1.0

"""Convert EnterpriseRAG-Bench S1 slices into the lab's knowledge-base JSON.

Input: the extracted v1.0.0 confluence + jira slices (see DATA.md and
evidence/c2-s1-mac-20260712/ for provenance and integrity records). Every
document file is named ``dsid_<32 hex>__<slug>.txt``; the ``dsid_*`` prefix is
the document id that ``questions.jsonl`` references via ``expected_doc_ids``.

Output: a knowledge-base JSON in the lab's schema — a list of
``{"id", "title", "content", "source_type"}`` records (``load_knowledge_base``
consumes ``id``/``title``/``content`` and ignores extras). The document id IS
the dsid, so retrieval scoring happens at dsid granularity. A dsid may map to
more than one file in the raw data (two known cases, recorded in
evidence/c2-s1-mac-20260712/README.md); those files stay separate records that
share an id — they are facets/versions of one logical document.

The conversion is deterministic: sources are processed in a fixed order and
files in sorted path order, so identical input slices (hash-verified across
machines) produce byte-identical output. The output file stays OUT of git
(~90 MB); integrity travels via data/MANIFEST.json.

Usage:
    python scripts/adapters/enterpriserag_s1_to_kb.py
    python scripts/adapters/enterpriserag_s1_to_kb.py \
        --extracted-dir data/enterpriserag-bench/v1.0.0/extracted \
        --output data/knowledge_base_enterpriserag_s1.json
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--extracted-dir", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_EXTRACTED_DIR)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    records, stats = build_kb_records(args.extracted_dir)

    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with args.output.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
        json.dump(records, file, ensure_ascii=False)
        file.write("\n")

    stats["output"] = str(args.output)
    stats["output_bytes"] = args.output.stat().st_size
    stats["output_sha256"] = sha256_of(args.output)
    print(json.dumps(stats, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0

    sys.exit(main())

## Why this exists · 为什么做

Text stays selectable under a PDF overlay, metadata still carries the original
filename, and uploading a document to a cloud reviewer leaks the original before
anything has been removed. `privacy-preflight` is a browser workspace for text,
images, and PDFs built on the stricter contract: detect locally, review as a
human, burn the content out, then re-open the exported file and check it — or
block the download. The repository is built around committed fixtures, a
committed benchmark artifact, and code-inspectable guarantees; the sections below
state for each claim what it does not establish. Deployed at
[xiangguozhang.com/ai/privacy-preflight](https://xiangguozhang.com/ai/privacy-preflight).

> PDF 覆盖层下的文字仍然可以被选中，metadata 里还留着原始文件名，而把文档传到云端审阅等于在删除任何内容之前先泄露一遍原文。`privacy-preflight` 是一个处理文本、图片和 PDF 的浏览器工作区，遵循更严格的约定：本地检测、人工复核、把内容烧掉，再重新打开导出文件逐项检查，检查不过就阻断下载。仓库里的结论只依赖已提交的 fixtures、已提交的 benchmark artifact 和可以直接读代码验证的性质；每条结论下面都写清楚它不能证明什么。

## Headline · 核心结果

**A redacted PDF becomes downloadable only after the exported bytes are re-opened
and pass all 7 <!-- src: src/components/privacy/PrivacyPdfLab.tsx --> post-export
checks; a single failing check leaves the download unavailable.** This is a
code-level contract, not a measurement: the export path computes
`safe = pageCount && dimensions && textLayerEmpty && annotationsEmpty && knownTermsAbsent && metadataClean && burnInVerified`
and returns before creating the object URL when `safe` is false
<!-- src: src/components/privacy/PrivacyPdfLab.tsx -->.

> 脱敏后的 PDF 只有在导出字节被重新打开、并通过全部 7 项导出后检查之后才可下载，任何一项失败都不会给出下载链接。这是代码层面的约定而非测量结果：导出流程先算出 7 项检查的合取，`safe` 为 false 时直接返回，不生成 object URL。

## Export gate · 导出闸门

Conditions: all statements below are read off the export code paths, not from a
run receipt. The PDF path renders every page at `EXPORT_SCALE = 2`
<!-- src: src/components/privacy/PrivacyPdfLab.tsx -->, burns accepted regions
into the pixels, rebuilds an image-only PDF, then re-parses the produced blob
with PDF.js before deciding.

> 前提：下面每一句都是从导出代码路径读出来的，不是来自一次运行的 receipt。PDF 路径以 `EXPORT_SCALE = 2` 渲染每一页，把已接受的区域烧进像素，重建一个纯图像 PDF，再用 PDF.js 重新解析产出的 blob，然后才决定是否放行。

| Check | Implementation | Blocks download on failure |
|---|---|---|
| Page count | re-parsed `numPages` equals source `numPages` | yes |
| Page dimensions | per-page width/height compared to source | yes |
| Extractable text empty | `getTextContent()` over all pages trims to `""` | yes |
| Annotations empty | `getAnnotations()` length 0 on every page | yes |
| Known terms absent | accepted region texts not found in extracted text | yes |
| Original metadata absent | original filename and region texts absent from metadata | yes |
| Burn-in pixels | sampled pixel is opaque black (R,G,B < 8, A > 245) | yes |

Boundaries. "Known terms absent" only tests strings the reviewer accepted as
regions; content the detector never proposed and the reviewer never boxed is not
searched for. The burn-in test samples pixels, so it confirms that black was
written where expected, not that every sensitive glyph was covered. The gate
proves that the exported artifact carries no extractable text layer, no
annotations, and no original metadata — it does not prove that the visual
redaction is semantically complete, and it is not legal-grade redaction or
compliance advice.

> 边界说明：Known terms absent 只检查复核者接受过的区域文本，检测器从没提出、复核者也没框选的内容不在检查范围内。烧录检查是采样像素，只能确认该黑的地方写了黑，不能确认所有敏感字形都被覆盖。这道闸门能证明导出文件没有可提取文字层、没有 annotation、没有原始 metadata，但不能证明视觉脱敏在语义上完整，也不构成法律意义上的脱敏或合规意见。

# margin-control-tower

*Verify the bytes before you trust the margin.*

> 先把字节校验清楚，再谈毛利结论。

[![CI](https://github.com/LucisZhang/margin-control-tower/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LucisZhang/margin-control-tower/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

## Why this exists · 为什么做

`margin-control-tower` turns a public Brazilian e-commerce dataset into a weekly
contribution-margin workbench that runs entirely in the browser. The task is
decision support for a category manager: locate where margin broke, attribute it to
a cost driver, and price one bounded promotion change against a held-out period.
The artifact is a hash-locked offline pipeline, one derived Parquet aggregate, two
measured evaluation reports bound to that Parquet's hash, and a Next.js +
DuckDB-WASM application that re-hashes the served artifact before it renders
anything. The evidence discipline is fail-closed verification over frozen bytes and
a fixed analysis/holdout split — the weak fits and the high false-positive rate are
published as measured, not tuned into a better story.

> `margin-control-tower` 把一份公开的巴西电商数据集做成浏览器内运行的周度 contribution margin 工作台。要解决的决策问题很具体：找出毛利在哪一周、哪个品类掉下去，归因到具体成本项，再拿一个有边界的促销调整去和 holdout 期对照。交付物是一条哈希锁定的离线 pipeline、一个派生 Parquet 聚合产物、两份与该 Parquet 哈希绑定的实测评估报告，以及一个渲染前先自己重算 SHA-256 的 Next.js + DuckDB-WASM 应用。证据纪律是 fail-closed 校验加固定的 analysis/holdout 切分——拟合很弱、假阳性很高的结果按实测原样发布，不做修饰。

workbench issues same-origin requests only and never contacts a CDN or a remote

## Detection replay · 异常检测重放

Measurement conditions: the 95 observed weekly contribution-margin totals are
reindexed onto a complete 106-Monday calendar from 2016-08-29 through 2018-09-03; the
11 Mondays with no derived cell are explicitly zero-filled. Six deterministic
fixed-location negative perturbations of −97,603.7505 each are then replayed on evenly
spaced observed Mondays, after 14-calendar-week boundary guards at both ends. The
detector is a 13-week robust STL residual scored by MAD-based robust z with threshold
3.5. Neither the zero-filled weeks nor the perturbations are ever written into the
Parquet artifact.

# Margin Control Tower — browser artifact boundary

This directory contains the files served to the in-browser decision workspace. The default path
is the committed, hash-verified Olist aggregate; the fixed-seed synthetic dataset is a separate
fallback and test fixture.

## Default Olist path

- `olist-margin.parquet` contains 15,809 aggregate rows derived from 99,441 Olist orders across
  six reconciled source tables. The browser verifies its recorded SHA-256 before rendering.
- `detection-report.json`, `elasticity-report.json`, and `methods-evidence.json` are measured
  offline reports bound to that exact Parquet hash. Detection scores characterize deterministic
  replay labels, not manually verified real anomalies. Elasticity is associational, not causal.
- `olist-margin-compact.json` is a hash-bound first-paint preview of the same Parquet artifact; it
  is not a substitute dataset.
- Observed item prices and freight are retained at the aggregate grain. Reference-price
  discounts, returns, and COGS are disclosed proxies rather than audited company economics.

The upstream Olist dataset is governed by CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Source authority, transport commit,
retrieval date, raw sizes and hashes, output identity, and proxy boundaries are recorded under
`pipelines/olist-margin/` and in the Parquet metadata. Raw relational rows are not committed.

## Synthetic fallback and test mode

`synthetic-margin-data.json`, CSV, and Parquet are generated from seed `2026071301`. They contain
9,360 fictional rows over 52 weeks and one labeled injected anomaly. This path exists for
deterministic fallback, scenario demonstration, and browser testing; its currency values and

`synthetic-margin-data.json`, CSV, and Parquet are generated from seed `2026071301`. They contain
9,360 fictional rows over 52 weeks and one labeled injected anomaly. This path exists for
deterministic fallback, scenario demonstration, and browser testing; its currency values and
holdout are synthetic and must not be presented as Olist measurements.

## Shared decision contract

Both modes use the same gross → net → contribution accounting identities, bounded rates,
analysis/holdout separation, provenance check, scenario assumptions, and fail-closed decision
gate. Their grains differ deliberately:

- Olist: `week × category × region × dominant payment channel`
- Synthetic fixture: `week × product × region × channel`

`data-contract.json` records the source-specific grains and checks. `metric-registry.json`
records the formulas and source-specific units/provenance. The workspace does not produce a
decision output when an applicable contract check fails.

## Limitations

This case study demonstrates deterministic analytics engineering, browser artifact verification,
measured offline evaluation, and explicit proxy governance. It does not establish audited COGS,
causal promotion lift, manually verified real anomalies, production decisioning, or commercial
impact.

## Reconciliation and boundaries

1. Collapse multiple payments to the channel with the greatest summed payment value; ties are
   deterministic.
2. Collapse multiple reviews to the lowest score so an adverse report is not silently discarded.
3. Map Brazilian states to three display regions: North includes North + Northeast; South includes
   South + Southeast; West includes Central-West.
4. Retain missing categories as `unknown`; audit payment versus item-price-plus-freight gaps.
5. Aggregate to `week x product_category x region x dominant payment channel` only after joins.
6. Gross revenue uses an observed-or-higher shifted expanding category median reference price;
   discounts are the difference from observed item price and are capped at 50% by construction.
   A category's first observed week has no prior median, so those item rows explicitly fall back to
   their current price and receive zero proxy discount.

The final eight observed weeks are holdout. After the disclosed cold-start fallback, reference
prices are shifted. The elasticity coefficient is fit on analysis rows only; later holdout rows
evaluate MAPE only.

placed only on observed Mondays after 14-calendar-week boundary guards. Neither the zero-fill rows

def build_elasticity_report(margin: pd.DataFrame, dataset_id: str, artifact_hash: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    import statsmodels.api as sm

    frame = margin.copy()
    frame["realized_price"] = (frame["gross_revenue"] - frame["discounts"]) / frame["units"]
    frame["log_units"] = np.log1p(frame["units"].astype(float))

    frame["realized_price"] = (frame["gross_revenue"] - frame["discounts"]) / frame["units"]
    frame["log_units"] = np.log1p(frame["units"].astype(float))
    frame["log_price"] = np.log(frame["realized_price"].clip(lower=0.01))
    split = frame["period_split"].eq("analysis")
    combined = pd.concat([
        frame[["log_price"]],
        pd.get_dummies(frame[["category", "region", "channel"]], drop_first=True, dtype=float),
    ], axis=1)
    design = sm.add_constant(combined, has_constant="add").astype(float)
    model = sm.OLS(frame.loc[split, "log_units"], design.loc[split]).fit(cov_type="HC3")
    predicted_units = np.expm1(model.predict(design.loc[~split])).clip(lower=0)
    actual_units = frame.loc[~split, "units"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    holdout_mape = float(np.mean(np.abs(predicted_units - actual_units) / np.maximum(actual_units, 1.0)))
    coefficient = float(model.params["log_price"])
    interval = model.conf_int().loc["log_price"].tolist()
    return {

# credit-policy-desk

*A score is not a decision. Keep the layers apart, and keep the receipts.*

> 分数不等于决策：概率、损失经济、策略阈值与人工复核分层留痕，每一层都能回查。

[![CI](https://github.com/LucisZhang/credit-policy-desk/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LucisZhang/credit-policy-desk/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

## Why this exists · 为什么做

`credit-policy-desk` builds an offline credit-risk backtest from a pinned public
Lending Club granting archive, scores it with a calibrated baseline and a
challenger, and ships the result as a single hash-pinned Parquet artifact that a
browser workflow verifies byte-for-byte before it will apply any policy threshold.
The repository keeps probability, expected-loss economics, approve/review/decline
bands, analyst review capacity, and the audit record as separate stages, and it
retains the measurement that did not go the intended way—the challenger did not
beat the calibrated baseline.

> 这个项目基于固定的 Lending Club 公开授信档案做离线信贷回测，用校准后的 baseline 与 challenger 分别打分，产物是一份哈希锁定的 Parquet；浏览器侧必须先逐字节校验该 artifact，才会应用任何策略阈值。概率、预期损失、批准/复核/拒绝分带、复核容量与审计记录各自独立成层，负结果也照原样保留——challenger 并没有跑赢校准后的 baseline。

## Quickstart · 快速开始

The browser workflow uses only committed artifacts. It needs no credential, no
GPU, and no paid API:

> 浏览器侧只使用仓库里已提交的产物，不需要任何凭证，不需要 GPU，也不调用付费 API：

```bash
npm ci
npm run dev
```

Open `http://localhost:3000`. The UI requests the committed scored Parquet,
hashes the fetched bytes with `crypto.subtle`, refuses any path outside
`/case-studies/*.parquet`, and runs ten data-contract checks before the policy
layer is usable. The DuckDB-WASM runtime, its worker, and the `parquet` extension
are served from this origin under `public/duckdb/`, with

## Headline · 核心结果

**The 240-tree depth-4 XGBoost challenger did not beat the L2 logistic baseline on
this task.** On n=24,000 held-out later-vintage applications, isotonic-calibrated
baseline Brier is **0.15928048** and isotonic-calibrated challenger Brier is
**0.15925265**—a **0.00002783** gap—while ROC AUC is **0.67461544** versus
**0.67526164**. <!-- src: public/case-studies/credit-policy-lab/backtest-report.json --> No
bootstrap, DeLong, or paired interval is committed in this repository, so neither
gap is established as distinguishable from sampling noise.

> **challenger（240 棵、深度 4 的 XGBoost）在本任务上没有跑赢 L2 逻辑回归 baseline。** 在 n=24,000 条更晚 vintage 的样本上，isotonic 校准后 baseline Brier 为 0.15928048，challenger 为 0.15925265，差距 0.00002783；ROC AUC 分别是 0.67461544 与 0.67526164。仓库里没有提交 bootstrap、DeLong 或 paired 区间，因此这两个差距都不能判定为超出抽样噪声。

**72,000 train / 24,000 calibration / 24,000 backtest**; preprocessing and the DTI
cap fit on train only; both isotonic maps fit on calibration only; every reported
metric computed on backtest outcomes after rereading the final Parquet.

## Policy layer and its inputs · 策略层与输入假设

The policy layer is deliberately downstream of the model and is driven by operator
inputs, not by fitted values. Expected loss is `PD x LGD x EAD`. **LGD is a
disclosed flat 45% assumption** and EAD is the requested amount; neither is
estimated from data.

## Limitations and negative results · 局限与负结果

- The challenger XGBoost produced no separable gain: Brier 0.15925265 versus
  baseline 0.15928048, AUC 0.67526164 versus 0.67461544, on n=24,000 with no
  committed interval. <!-- src: public/case-studies/credit-policy-lab/backtest-report.json -->
  The result is retained as measured. It does not show that gradient boosting is
  unhelpful for credit risk generally; it shows that on nine application-time
  features from this archive, with this split, it did not separate from a
  regularized logistic baseline.

> challenger XGBoost 没有产生可区分的增益：Brier 0.15925265 对 baseline 0.15928048，AUC 0.67526164 对 0.67461544，n=24,000 且仓库未提交任何区间。结果按实测保留。这不说明 gradient boosting 对信贷风险普遍无效，只说明在这份档案的 9 个申请时点特征、这一组切分下，它没有和正则化逻辑回归拉开差距。

- No confidence interval, bootstrap resample, or significance test is committed
  anywhere in this repository. Every metric here is a single point estimate on one
  frozen split. Differences at the fourth or fifth decimal place should be read as
  "not separated", not as a ranking.

> 仓库里没有提交任何置信区间、bootstrap 重采样或显著性检验。这里的每个指标都是单一切分上的点估计；小数点后第四、第五位的差异应读作「没有分开」，而不是排名。

# Credit Policy Desk

Live route: https://xiangguozhang.com/analytics/credit-policy-desk (the on-disk artifact directory name `credit-policy-lab` is unchanged).

Status: dual-source evidence bundle and real-data browser runtime copied back from the current
Portfolio integration. The standalone UI requests the committed scored Lending Club artifact by
default and fails closed to a separately labeled fixed-seed synthetic fallback when real bytes are
missing or invalid. The local pipeline and verified real-data outputs below remain authoritative
for the real-data path.

## Decision workflow

A credit policy manager compares baseline and challenger PD, applies approval/review thresholds,
computes expected loss from disclosed PD/LGD/EAD inputs, manages review capacity, and records a
policy decision. Model scores, economics, policy, human review, and audit remain separate stages.

## Synthetic fallback

`synthetic-credit-data.json` and CSV are generated by `npm run generate:analytics` with fixed seed
`2026071302`. They contain 12,000 fictional applications across 12 synthetic vintages with explicit
train/calibration/backtest splits, generated outcomes, deterministic scores, no PII, and no
external credit records. The fixture is covered by the portfolio `NOTICE.md`; its metrics are not
real-model validation.

## Committed real artifact

Real mode loads [scored-backtest.parquet](scored-backtest.parquet), a 120,000-row deterministic
sample from the 1,347,681-row UCM-curated Lending Club granting archive. It contains disjoint
72,000 train / 24,000 isotonic-calibration / 24,000 later-backtest rows, observed final outcomes,
offline logistic/XGBoost scores, and three directional SHAP reason codes per application.

- Authority: [Zenodo record 11295916](https://zenodo.org/records/11295916)
- DOI: [10.5281/zenodo.11295916](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.11295916)

- Provenance: [source, transport, attribution, and output hashes](../../../pipelines/credit-backtest/PROVENANCE.md)

Raw source rows, direct IDs, ZIP, title, and description are not committed. Published identifiers
are deterministic pseudonyms: linkable within the artifact and dictionary-linkable by a holder of
the public source, not anonymous. The exact output-schema gate, 95 MiB browser budget, time split,
score bounds, outcome types, and reason-code contract fail closed.

## Modeling and claim boundaries

- Baseline: L2-regularized logistic regression; challenger: depth-4 XGBoost. Both use nine disclosed
  application-time source features and are independently isotonic-calibrated on the calibration
  window. Score columns retain float64 precision; all reported model metrics use the later backtest
  window and are computed after rereading the final Parquet.
- EAD is requested amount. LGD is a disclosed 45% assumption. Legacy browser fields absent from the

verification. It does not claim causal impact, live or production decisioning, regulatory

# Credit backtest pipeline

This offline pipeline produces the default real-data scored artifact for Credit Policy Lab. It
does not remove or overwrite the fixed-seed synthetic fixture, which remains a separately labeled

def build_transformer() -> ColumnTransformer:
    from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
    from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
    from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
    from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler

    numeric = Pipeline([("impute", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")), ("scale", StandardScaler())])

# Voice in Security：本地部署指南 / Voice in Security: Local Deployment Guide

## 1. 项目简介 / Project Overview

本项目是一个面向信息安全课程展示的声纹识别演示系统，包含本地 Python 后端与静态前端。  
This project is a speaker verification demo for an Information Security presentation, with a local Python backend and a static frontend.

后端使用 SpeechBrain 的 ECAPA-TDNN 模型提取说话人嵌入，前端提供注册、验证、鲁棒性分析以及 PCA/t-SNE 投影可视化。  
The backend uses SpeechBrain's ECAPA-TDNN model to extract speaker embeddings, while the frontend provides enrollment, verification, robustness analysis, and PCA/t-SNE projection.

本 README 重点讲本地部署，因为这是当前最稳定、最适合课堂演示的运行方式。  
This README focuses on local deployment because it is currently the most stable option for classroom presentations.

---

## 2. 环境要求 / Prerequisites

1. 你需要一台 macOS 或 Linux 电脑。  
   You need a macOS or Linux machine.

2. 你需要安装 Python 3.11 或 3.12。  
   You need Python 3.11 or 3.12 installed.

3. 你需要使用 Chrome 或 Edge 打开前端页面，以便使用 `getUserMedia` 录音。  
   You should use Chrome or Edge for the frontend so `getUserMedia` microphone capture works correctly.

4. 第一次运行会下载 SpeechBrain 的 ECAPA-TDNN 模型，大小大约 80MB 左右，因此需要联网。  
   The first run downloads the SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN model, roughly 80 MB, so internet access is required.

5. 你需要允许浏览器访问麦克风。  
   You need to allow microphone access in the browser.

---

### 8.1 `5000` 端口被占用 / Port `5000` Is Already Occupied

这是 macOS 上常见的问题，通常是系统的 `ControlCenter` / AirPlay Receiver 在占用 `5000`。

现在的一键脚本会自动跳到 `5050` 或其他空闲端口，所以通常不用手动处理。

### 8.2 浏览器提示无法访问麦克风 / Browser Cannot Access the Microphone

### 8.5 Robustness 图表越来越乱 / The Robustness Charts Keep Getting Messier

def _butter_filter(
    audio: "np.ndarray",
    sr: int,
    *,
    low_hz: float | None = None,
    high_hz: float | None = None,
    order: int = 4,
) -> "np.ndarray":
    _require_audio_stack()
    nyquist = sr / 2.0
    if low_hz and high_hz:
        btype = "band"
        cutoff = [low_hz / nyquist, high_hz / nyquist]
    elif low_hz:
        btype = "high"
        cutoff = low_hz / nyquist
    elif high_hz:
        btype = "low"
        cutoff = high_hz / nyquist
    else:
        return audio
    b, a = butter(order, cutoff, btype=btype)
    return filtfilt(b, a, audio).astype(np.float32)


def _generate_ambient_noise(length: int, sr: int, noise_type: str = "office") -> "np.ndarray":
    _require_audio_stack()
    rng = np.random.default_rng()
    t = np.arange(length, dtype=np.float32) / float(sr)

    base = rng.normal(0.0, 1.0, length).astype(np.float32)
    low_rumble = 0.6 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 63.0 * t + rng.uniform(0, np.pi))
    mid_rumble = 0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 180.0 * t + rng.uniform(0, np.pi))

    if noise_type == "street":
        passing = 0.35 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 420.0 * t + rng.uniform(0, np.pi))
        shaped = 0.85 * base + low_rumble + passing
    elif noise_type == "cafe":
        chatter = (0.4 + 0.3 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1.4 * t)) * base
        clatter = 0.18 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2100.0 * t + rng.uniform(0, np.pi))
        shaped = chatter + mid_rumble + clatter
    else:
        fan = 0.4 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 120.0 * t + rng.uniform(0, np.pi))
        keyboard = 0.12 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1600.0 * t + rng.uniform(0, np.pi))
        shaped = 0.7 * base + fan + keyboard

else:
        fan = 0.4 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 120.0 * t + rng.uniform(0, np.pi))
        keyboard = 0.12 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1600.0 * t + rng.uniform(0, np.pi))
        shaped = 0.7 * base + fan + keyboard

    shaped = _butter_filter(shaped.astype(np.float32), sr, low_hz=40.0, high_hz=6000.0, order=2)
    return _normalize(shaped)


def simulate_cold(audio: Any, sr: int) -> "np.ndarray":
    """Pitch-shift and add jitter/breathiness to mimic a congested voice."""
    _require_audio_stack()
    source = _normalize(audio)
    pitched = librosa.effects.pitch_shift(source, sr=sr, n_steps=2.2)
    congested = _butter_filter(pitched.astype(np.float32), sr, high_hz=3300.0, order=4)
    jitter = np.random.normal(0.0, 0.0025, congested.shape[0]).astype(np.float32)
    breath = _butter_filter(
        np.random.normal(0.0, 0.018, congested.shape[0]).astype(np.float32),
        sr,
        low_hz=1800.0,
        high_hz=6000.0,
        order=2,
    )
    return _normalize(0.95 * congested + 0.05 * breath + jitter)


def simulate_accent(audio: Any, sr: int) -> "np.ndarray":
    """Approximate accent variation with a subtle speaking-rate and formant proxy shift."""
    _require_audio_stack()
    source = _normalize(audio)
    stretched = librosa.effects.time_stretch(source, rate=0.94)
    shifted = librosa.effects.pitch_shift(stretched.astype(np.float32), sr=sr, n_steps=0.7)
    body = _butter_filter(shifted.astype(np.float32), sr, low_hz=130.0, high_hz=3800.0, order=3)
    sparkle = _butter_filter(shifted.astype(np.float32), sr, low_hz=2500.0, order=2)
    combined = 0.88 * body + 0.18 * sparkle
    return _normalize(combined)

# frontier-forge

*Know your frontier. Then forge past it.*

> 先看清模型能力边界，再用可复查的实验把边界向前推。

[![CI](https://github.com/LucisZhang/frontier-forge/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LucisZhang/frontier-forge/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

## Why this exists · 为什么做

`frontier-forge` post-trains a 4B base model for machine-verifiable CFPB complaint
triage, serves it with vLLM, and puts a C++20 token-aware gateway in front of it.
The release is built around frozen splits, paired confidence intervals, measured
cost, and retained negative results—not a best-checkpoint victory lap.

> 这个项目围绕可机器验证的 CFPB 投诉分流任务，对 4B base model 做 post-training，以 vLLM 提供服务，并在前面部署 C++20 token-aware gateway。所有结论都绑定 frozen splits、paired CI、实测成本和保留的负结果，不以单个最佳 checkpoint 代替完整记录。

# Frontier Forge R1b

Frontier Forge R1b is a Qwen3.5-4B-Base derivative post-trained to turn a CFPB
consumer-complaint narrative plus source metadata into a strict structured triage
ticket and one tool call. It is a research artifact for reproducible post-training,
serving, and gateway experiments—not a consumer-decision system.

The source adapter was trained with NF4 QLoRA. GPTQ is a separate

## Intended task and input contract

The input contract is JSON with five fields:

```json
{
  "complaint_id": 123,
  "narrative": "consumer complaint text",
  "source_product": "Mortgage",
  "source_issue": "Trouble during payment process",

"complaint_id": 123,
  "narrative": "consumer complaint text",
  "source_product": "Mortgage",
  "source_issue": "Trouble during payment process",
  "source_company": "Example Company"
}
```

The output is strict JSON containing normalized `product`, `issue`, `company`,
`urgency`, `ambiguity_flag`, and exactly one `tool_call`. Allowed tools are
`request_more_info`, `close_no_action`, `escalate_to_regulator`,
`start_refund_workflow`, and `route_to_company`.

Source metadata is intentionally model-visible. This matches a triage workflow in
which upstream intake metadata already exists, but it means the model must **not**
be presented as a leakage-free narrative-only product classifier.

## Training

- Base: Qwen3.5-4B-Base, pretrained-only checkpoint.
- Rung: R1b, one epoch of language-model-only QLoRA SFT.
- Training seed: 0; no multi-seed R1b aggregate exists.
- Data: 20,000 deterministic rule-labeled TRAIN examples, disjoint from frozen
  TEST-IID and TEST-DRIFT under a 13-token contamination audit.
- LoRA: rank 16, alpha 32, dropout 0; attention and MLP projection targets; visual
  subtree excluded.
- Full-run precision: NF4 QLoRA training, BF16 evaluation.
- Hardware/cost: 15.2358 RTX 4090 GPU-hours at the owner-supplied $0.30/hour rate,

## Uses

Appropriate uses:

- reproducing the documented structured-output evaluation;
- studying rule-label scaling, quantized deployment, native MTP, or constrained
  generation;

Out-of-scope uses:

- autonomous regulatory, credit, legal, refund, or account actions;
- narrative-only product classification claims;
- deployment outside the tested English CFPB taxonomy without new evaluation;
- handling live personal data without a separate privacy/security review.

# Phase 7.2 single-node serving runbook

This runbook is deliberately scoped to one k3s node and one physical A10 GPU.
It is an operational rehearsal, not evidence of cloud production or multi-GPU
autoscaling. All services are `ClusterIP`; operators reach Grafana, Prometheus,
and the gateway only through loopback-bound SSH tunnels.

## Preconditions

1. Verify the node is a real systemd VM with cgroup v2, no swap, and an idle A10.
2. Verify both immutable model trees against `deploy/phase7_2/versions.lock.yaml`.
3. Verify the NVIDIA device plugin reports exactly two
   `nvidia.com/gpu.shared` time-sliced allocations backed by the one physical GPU.
4. Verify no `NodePort`, `LoadBalancer`, or `hostPort` exists in the Phase 7.2
   manifests.

## Dashboard access

On the operator machine, bind only loopback addresses:

```sh
ssh -F .remote/ssh_config \
  -L 13000:127.0.0.1:13000 \

On the VM, run loopback-only port-forwards for Grafana and Prometheus. Never
create a NodePort or change a security-group rule for dashboard access.

## Drill 1: kill the active vLLM pod

Goal: prove the GPU workload can be recreated and the gateway fails closed while
the upstream is unavailable.

1. Record the current pod UID and a successful verified request.
2. Delete that exact `vllm-int4` pod.
3. Confirm the gateway returns `503/unavailable`, not a fabricated success.
4. Wait for a different pod UID to become Ready and send the same verified
   request again.
5. Save timestamps, UIDs, statuses, and recovery latency in the drill receipt.

## Drill 2: saturate gateway admission

Goal: prove CPU replica scaling and bounded-overload behavior.

## Drill 2: saturate gateway admission

Goal: prove CPU replica scaling and bounded-overload behavior.

1. Run the `saturation` k6 scenario.
2. Capture queue depth, HPA/KEDA events, gateway replica counts, and 429 samples.
3. Require at least one scale-up event and at least one 429 carrying
   `Retry-After` after the bounded queue saturates.
4. Stop load and confirm the gateway returns to the configured minimum replica
   count after its cooldown.

## Drill 3: bad canary and rollback

Goal: exercise a release decision, not merely edit a manifest.

1. Start GPTQ-int4 and BF16 together using the two time-sliced GPU allocations.
2. Move traffic through the recorded 10%, 50%, and 100% router configurations,
   checking the SLO queries at every step.
3. Route the promoted path to the controlled HTTP-500 upstream.
4. Require the availability burn-rate alert to enter `firing`.
5. Roll back to the stable GPTQ-int4 router configuration and require a verified
   request to recover.
6. Preserve the unhealthy interval and alert payload; never erase the failed
   canary evidence.

## Availability burn

`ForgeAvailabilityBurnRate` combines 30-second and 2-minute error ratios against
the 99% availability objective. The injected HTTP-500 upstream keeps `/health`
healthy so the request reaches the upstream and is counted as a real gateway 5xx.

`ForgeLatencyBurnRate` combines 30-second and 2-minute ratios of requests above

## Shutdown

1. Restore the stable router configuration and set GPU demand to zero.
2. Stop all port-forwards and test Jobs.

# Phase 5 gateway remote benchmark report

Status: **complete with a known overload limitation**. Run `phase5_gateway_r1b_bf16_native_mtp` on git `9dff2a6758a1ed2facd5f132d0f22de182a592bb`; baseline gateway git `2c5d6a4a364f13e84e999dfd78d32288d002f205`. Raw receipt: `results/phase5/raw/phase5_gateway_bench.json`.

## Result

- Bare-vLLM measured capacity: **2.000 QPS**; max stable observed concurrency **6**.
- Across 5 stable direct/gateway cells, median gateway E2E overhead was **p50 0.3% / p95 0.5%**; median throughput delta **-0.9%**.
- Profile-driven optimization: `Adaptive queued-admission polling backoff from 5 ms to 10 ms and then 20 ms while preserving immediate first admission and deadline semantics`. Matched profile cell E2E p50 changed **3.655 → 3.821 s (4.5%)**; throughput **7.752 → 8.029 req/s (3.6%)**.
- **Known limitation:** every overload error was an admitted `primary` request returning HTTP 502/`upstream_error`; `reject_overload=0`, so this run did **not** demonstrate the designed 429 admission fast-reject path. In the non-stable concurrency/length cells, gateway error rates were **10–85%** while the paired bare-vLLM cells were **0%**. Lower success-only p95 values in those cells are survivor-biased and are not latency wins. The connection-handling defect remains uncorrected in this measured build.

def _fmt(value: Any, digits: int = 3) -> str:
    return "n/a" if value is None else f"{float(value):.{digits}f}"


def _pct(value: Any) -> str:
    return "n/a" if value is None else f"{float(value) * 100:.1f}%"


def _count_status(cell: Mapping[str, Any], status: int) -> int:
    return int(cell.get("http_status_counts", {}).get(str(status), 0))


def _five_xx(cell: Mapping[str, Any]) -> int:
    return sum(
        int(count)
        for status, count in cell.get("http_status_counts", {}).items()
        if 500 <= int(status) < 600
    )


def _median_present(values: Iterable[float | None]) -> float | None:
    present = [float(value) for value in values if value is not None]

def _median_present(values: Iterable[float | None]) -> float | None:
    present = [float(value) for value in values if value is not None]
    return median(present) if present else None


def _stable_overhead(receipt: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    stable = [
        pair
        for pair in receipt["metrics"]["direct_gateway"]["pairs"]
        if float(pair["direct"]["error_rate"]) <= 0.05
        and float(pair["gateway"]["error_rate"]) <= 0.05
    ]
    return {
        "cells": len(stable),
        "p50": _median_present(pair["overhead"]["e2e_p50_overhead_pct"] for pair in stable),
        "p95": _median_present(pair["overhead"]["e2e_p95_overhead_pct"] for pair in stable),

def _a10_overload_table(receipt: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    lines = [
        "| 负载 | bare A10 5xx | gateway A10 5xx | gateway 429 | reject_overload | queue sampled/process | 429 p50 ms |",
        "|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
    ]
    gate_rows = {float(row["multiplier"]): row for row in receipt["gate"]["overload_cells"]}
    for pair in receipt["metrics"]["overload"]["pairs"]:
        gateway = pair["gateway"]
        gate = gate_rows[float(pair["multiplier"])]
        lines.append(
            "| {multiplier:g}× | {direct_5xx}/{requests} | {gateway_5xx}/{requests} | {rejects}/{requests} | {decisions} | {sampled}/{process} | {latency} |".format(
                multiplier=float(pair["multiplier"]),
                direct_5xx=_five_xx(pair["direct"]),
                gateway_5xx=_five_xx(gateway),
                rejects=_count_status(gateway, 429),

multiplier=float(pair["multiplier"]),
                direct_5xx=_five_xx(pair["direct"]),
                gateway_5xx=_five_xx(gateway),
                rejects=_count_status(gateway, 429),
                decisions=gate["reject_overload_decisions"],

    return "\n".join(lines)

                profile=pair["length_profile"],

                direct=_pct(direct_error),

                p50=_fmt(pair["overhead"]["e2e_p50_overhead_pct"], 1),
                p95=_fmt(pair["overhead"]["e2e_p95_overhead_pct"], 1),

direct=_pct(direct_error),

*Price the frontier before you buy the LLM.*

## Why this exists · 为什么做

`triage-router` builds a three-tier consumer-complaint triage system — TF-IDF plus a
calibrated linear model (Tier A), fine-tuned transformers (Tier B), Claude models
through OpenRouter (Tier C) — and then asks which routing policy is actually worth
buying under an explicit business cost model. The deliverable is a confidence-cascade
router whose escalation threshold is fitted on the calibration split only, plus an
append-only run log, per-call API receipts, and a static demo that runs the deployment
model in the browser. Every claim is bound to frozen temporal splits, paired bootstrap
intervals, and a gate that refuses to certify anything whose interval spans zero.

> 这个仓库把消费投诉分流做成三层系统：Tier A 是 TF-IDF + 校准线性模型，Tier B 是微调 transformer，Tier C 走 OpenRouter 调用 Claude。真正的问题不是哪一层最准，而是在一套写明参数的业务成本模型下，哪条路由策略值得买。交付物是一个 confidence-cascade router，escalation 阈值只在 calibration split 上拟合；配套还有 append-only 的 run log、逐次调用的 API receipts，以及把部署模型放进浏览器跑的静态 demo。所有结论都绑定 frozen temporal splits 与 paired bootstrap CI，区间跨零的一律不发证。

## Headline · 核心结果

**The certified router is `a_to_b`: a Tier A confidence gate in front of DistilBERT, not
in front of an LLM.** On the full frozen TEST-IID slice (n=104,443) it lowers expected
cost per 1,000 complaints by **$120.58 [$110.24, $131.04]** against the all-linear
policy while raising system macro-F1 by **+0.0370 [+0.0337, +0.0402]**. Both paired
95% bootstrap intervals exclude zero, which is what the gate requires before it will
call anything certified. Point costs are **$812.83/1k** for the router versus
**$933.41/1k** for all-linear, a **12.9183% [11.8266%, 13.9986%]** reduction, and
McNemar over the 104,443 machine-answered rows gives b=5,161 / c=3,062,
p=1.0169207274353265e-119. <!-- src: results/frontier/frontier__opv2__cost-2c969255.json -->

intervals whose widths do not compose. The point estimates are committed; the joint
interval is not computed. <!-- src: results/perturbation/summary.json -->

### 4.2 Near-duplicate removal (dedup)

CFPB narratives contain large volumes of near-duplicate template complaints (credit-report disputes especially). Near-duplicates are removed **before** splitting so that resubmitted or templated complaints cannot leak across the train/test boundary. Detection uses MinHash + LSH banding (datasketch): each narrative is normalized (lowercased, mask runs collapsed, non-alphanumerics stripped), shingled into word 5-grams, and signed with a fixed-seed 128-permutation MinHash; signatures are banded and union-found into near-duplicate clusters. Per cluster the earliest-dated record (tie-break: smallest complaint id) is kept and the rest dropped. The procedure is deterministic across runs and worker counts.

- **Output rows (post-dedup):** 1,983,496

## 6. Uses

The dataset supports supervised text classification (narrative → routing class), model calibration, confidence-cascade router evaluation against an explicit cost model, and temporal drift / prior-shift measurement across the frozen TEST-DRIFT and TEST-POSTCUTOFF slices. **Not suitable** for: any attempt to re-identify individuals (the text is opt-in and CFPB-scrubbed, and re-identification is out of scope and discouraged); demographic or fairness auditing (no demographic labels are present); or treating `Product` as ground-truth consumer intent (it is the company/CFPB routing category, harmonized here across taxonomy revisions).

Tokenization is chunked (~5k rows/chunk) and the raw texts are released + `gc`'d before
GPU training, so CPU RAM stays bounded; watch the `[tokenize:*] N/M rows rss=…MB` lines.
Each run prints hardware/precision/wall-clock and the final CAL macro-F1, and writes into
its `--out`:

- the checkpoint: `model.safetensors` + `config.json` (with `id2label`) + tokenizer files
- `training_log.jsonl` — per-step loss + per-epoch CAL metrics (**the training curve**)
- `training_meta.json` — hardware, wall-clock, effective batch, key-lib versions, data
  manifest sha, **measured truncation rate**, seed, label order

If ModernBERT OOMs on a T4: lower `per_device_batch_size` to 8 and raise `grad_accum` to
4 in the config (keeps effective batch 32) — but note that edits the config's hash, so
re-export is a new config identity; prefer a bigger GPU if you want the shipped configs
verbatim.

### 4a. Shared Jupyter A6000 — detached, preemptible, resumable runs

On a shared box the run must **survive the terminal/kernel dying** and be **stoppable**
so you free the GPU without losing progress. Training saves a full resumable checkpoint
every `training.save_steps` steps (500 by default; ~19/epoch on the A6000's ~9.4k
steps/epoch) and auto-resumes from the latest complete one.

**Start (detached, survives terminal/kernel death):**

```bash
cd <bundle dir>            # where you untarred tier_b_colab_bundle.tar.gz
mkdir -p logs ckpt
setsid nohup python -u train_tier_b.py \
    --config tier_b1_modernbert_sa.yaml --data-dir tier_b_kit --out ckpt/tier_b1_sa \
    > logs/tier_b1_sa.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
disown
```

`setsid` puts it in its own session (no controlling terminal), `nohup` ignores SIGHUP,
`</dev/null` + `&` + `disown` fully detach it — closing the terminal or restarting the
Jupyter kernel does not kill it. (macOS has no `setsid`; there use `nohup … & disown`.)

**Check status** (atomic JSON, safe to read any time):

```bash
cat ckpt/tier_b1_sa/status.json     # current_step, total_steps, latest_complete_checkpoint,
                                    # last_eval_metrics, exit_status, resume_command
tail -f logs/tier_b1_sa.log         # live progress
```

**Request a graceful stop** (frees the GPU at the next step boundary, after writing a
checkpoint — never mid-write):

```bash
touch ckpt/tier_b1_sa/STOP_REQUESTED
# process saves a checkpoint, sets status.exit_status="stopped", exits with code 42
```

**Resume** — delete the sentinel and rerun the *exact same* command; it auto-resumes from
the latest complete checkpoint (never restarts from step 0 while resumable state exists):

```

**Resume** — delete the sentinel and rerun the *exact same* command; it auto-resumes from
the latest complete checkpoint (never restarts from step 0 while resumable state exists):

```bash
rm -f ckpt/tier_b1_sa/STOP_REQUESTED
setsid nohup python -u train_tier_b.py \
    --config tier_b1_modernbert_sa.yaml --data-dir tier_b_kit --out ckpt/tier_b1_sa \
    > logs/tier_b1_sa.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
disown
```

**Exit codes:** `0` completed · `42` stopped (resumable) · `2` refused (another live run
holds the lock, or all on-disk checkpoints are corrupt — it fails loud, never silently
restarts). A second concurrent launch to the same `--out` is rejected by the pid lock.

**On successful completion:** `model.safetensors` + `training_meta.json` land at the
`--out` root (what the eval harness loads); the intermediate `hf_trainer/checkpoint-*`
dirs are deleted (shared-disk hygiene). On a stop/crash they are retained for resume.

Optional flags: `--save-steps N` overrides the checkpoint interval; `--cpu` forces
deterministic CPU (used only for the resume-equivalence proof, never for real runs).

## max_seq_length note

Both real configs use `max_seq_length = 256`. TRAIN narratives run long (word-count
p50≈135, p90≈419), so 256 subword tokens truncates the long tail — the exact realized
rate is measured per run and stored in `training_meta.json`. Rationale: product-class
signal is front-loaded in complaints, and the B2 deployment story (int8 in-browser)
favors short sequences for latency; keeping B1 and B2 at the same length also keeps the
B1-vs-B2 comparison clean. Revisit only if per-class truncation turns out to be skewed
toward a product that then underperforms.

# crossover-study

*Find the crossover. Or report that it is not there.*

> 找出个性化开始胜过热门推荐的那个历史深度；如果它不存在，就把「不存在」如实报出来。

[![CI](https://github.com/LucisZhang/crossover-study/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LucisZhang/crossover-study/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

## Why this exists · 为什么做

`crossover-study` asks how much user history is needed before personalized ranking
beats trailing-12-month popularity, and answers it twice: once on 43,886,944 Amazon
Electronics reviews <!-- src: data/MANIFEST.md --> and once on the 32,000,204-rating
MovieLens-32M catalog <!-- src: data/MANIFEST_ML32M.md -->.
The artifact is a contract-checked Spark + Iceberg lakehouse, a full-catalog ranking
harness with user-bootstrap confidence intervals, and an append-only run log in which
every published number is a record. The Amazon answer is a null, it is published as a
null, and the mechanism behind it is measured rather than argued.

> 这个仓库回答一个问题：用户要积累多少历史，个性化排序才会胜过过去 12 个月的热门推荐。答案测了两遍：一遍在 43,886,944 条 Amazon Electronics 评论上，一遍在 32,000,204 条评分的 MovieLens-32M 上。交付物是一条契约校验过的 Spark + Iceberg 数据管线、一套全目录排序与 user-bootstrap CI 的评测框架，以及一份 append-only 的运行记录——README 里每个数字都对应其中一条 record。Amazon 侧的结论是 null，就按 null 发布，并把背后的机制测出来，而不是讲道理。 <!-- src: data/MANIFEST.md; results/runs.jsonl -->

## Headline · 核心结果

**No history-depth crossover exists on Amazon Electronics.** The ALS, item-kNN and
pure-content arms lose to trailing-12-month popularity globally and in every history
segment, with every paired 95% bootstrap CI excluding zero, over **n=228,153**
frozen-TEST users ranking a full **368,228-item** catalog
<!-- src: results/runs.jsonl (paired_delta 20260807T085819Z-c320c79; regime_map 20260817T095926Z-633d454) -->.
The one arm that beats popularity is popularity itself, re-ranked by a MiniLM content
score at α=0.3: NDCG@10 **0.005726 [0.005524, 0.005948]** against popularity's
**0.005404 [0.005209, 0.005635]**, a paired delta of **+0.000322 [+0.000200, +0.000449]**

## Catalog turnover · 目录换血

The mechanism behind the Amazon null is a count, not an interpretation. **41.11%** of
2023 TEST ground-truth purchase mass lands on items whose TRAIN support is 0–4. Within
that, **34.54%** sits on items with zero TRAIN support, which a TRAIN-frozen factor
model cannot represent at all — a **65.5%** Recall@K ceiling before any modeling choice
is made. Requiring core support of at least 5 lowers the ceiling to **58.9%**
<!-- src: results/runs.jsonl (regime_map 20260817T095926Z-633d454, results.headline.gt_interactions_by_support) -->.

> Amazon 侧的 null 有一个数得出来的机制。2023 TEST 的 ground-truth 购买量里，41.11% 落在 TRAIN support 为 0–4 的商品上；其中 34.54% 的 support 完全为 0，TRAIN-frozen factor model 根本无法表示，Recall@K 上限因此只有 65.5%——这在任何建模选择之前就定了。若要求 core support ≥5，上限降到 58.9%。 <!-- src: results/runs.jsonl -->

## Routing policy · 路由结论

The fitted Amazon routing policy is `n*=∞`: every finite history-depth threshold scores
worse than sending every user to the blend, so the optimal routing is no routing
<!-- src: results/runs.jsonl (policy_grid 20260808T030659Z-43c90c8) -->. The grid is a
labeled **derived** exhibit — an arithmetic recomposition of per-user metric vectors
already recorded by the one-shot TEST evals named in its `source_run_ids`, regrouped by
the frozen segment edges. No re-scoring, no refitting, and `n*` was selected on VAL only.

> Amazon 侧拟合出的路由策略是 `n*=∞`：所有有限阈值都比「全部走 blend」更差，所以最优路由就是不路由。这张 grid 明确标为 derived——它是对一次性 TEST eval 已记录的 per-user 指标向量按冻结分段边界做的算术重组，没有重新打分、没有重新拟合，`n*` 只在 VAL 上选。 <!-- src: results/runs.jsonl -->

## Rules every document obeys

1. **Projection only.** A number may appear here only if it is byte-identical
   to a value reachable from (a) a `results/runs.jsonl` record, (b) a results
   artifact whose SHA-256 a record carries, or (c) a per-user parquet a record
   names in `per_user_artifact`. Anything else is appended to the log as a
   derived record *first*, then exported.
2. **Full precision.** Values are written exactly as recorded — no rounding,
   ever. Display rounding belongs in `demo/js/fmt.js`.
3. **Every numeric leaf is traced.** Written through `TracedWriter`, which

derived record *first*, then exported.
2. **Full precision.** Values are written exactly as recorded — no rounding,
   ever. Display rounding belongs in `demo/js/fmt.js`.
3. **Every numeric leaf is traced.** Written through `TracedWriter`, which
   emits a `trace_manifest.json` entry for it. The only exceptions are leaves
   explicitly declared *descriptive* (labels, ordering, `schema_version`),
   which the manifest records in its `descriptive` list.
4. **No timestamps in documents.** Re-exporting unchanged evidence is
   byte-stable; only `trace_manifest.json` carries `generated_at`. This lets
   the manifest pin each document's SHA-256.
5. **Segment keys** are always the frozen five, in this order:
   `"0"`, `"1-4"`, `"5-9"`, `"10-19"`, `"20+"`.
6. **Metric keys** are the record's own keys: `ndcg@10`, `recall@20`, …
   (`@` is not escaped; JSON pointers only escape `~` and `/`).

# groupconv-atlas

*Measure where the kernel wins, and whether the block keeps the gain.*

> 逐形状量清内核在哪里变快，再检查收益能否留在完整模块里。

[![CPU correctness](https://github.com/LucisZhang/groupconv-atlas/actions/workflows/cpu.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LucisZhang/groupconv-atlas/actions/workflows/cpu.yml)

## Why this exists · 为什么做

**GroupConv Atlas** asks when a custom grouped-convolution kernel is worth using.
The work spans four CUDA implementations, CPU/OpenMP and Apple OpenCL references,
a Triton subset, and a measurement pipeline that keeps complete outputs, raw timing
batches, unsupported shapes and losing results together. The central finding is
mixed: register reuse improves the direct CUDA baseline, while tuned PyTorch
remains faster across the full Atlas.

> GroupConv Atlas研究自定义分组卷积内核何时值得使用。项目实现并比较四个CUDA版本，配套CPU/OpenMP、Apple OpenCL参考和Triton子集，把完整输出校验、原始计时批次、不支持项与退化结果放进同一套实验。主要发现并不单向：寄存器复用改进了直接CUDA实现，但在完整Atlas上仍未超过调优PyTorch。

## Why the gains stop · 收益在哪里失效

**Shared memory has a cost.** In the six supported Nsight representative points,
k2 is shorter than k1 at two points and longer at four. Its shared halo adds
cooperative loading and barriers; the measured binary retains those operations.
The counter and code observations support a tradeoff, but do not isolate bank
conflicts or synchronization as the sole cause. These are single profiler captures,
separate from ordinary timing and its confidence classifications.
[Counter and SM89 review](results/rtx4090/session-20260908-vast-03/analysis-profile/mechanism-review.zh-CN.md).

> 六个支持的Nsight代表点中，k2只在两个点比k1短，另外四个更长。共享halo带来输入复用，也增加协作加载和同步；实测二进制保留了这些操作。计数器与代码能解释其中的取舍，但不能把慢幅单独归因于bank conflict或barrier。这里比较的是单次profile采集，不能替代普通计时的置信判定。[计数器与实际SM89机器码](results/rtx4090/session-20260908-vast-03/analysis-profile/mechanism-review.zh-CN.md)。

**A faster graph does not imply a faster call.** The N=4 MobileNetV2 block retains
a Graph gain, yet synchronized API slows down. At N=1 the Graph ratio is 1.04879
(TIE), and API is 0.66465 (LOSS). Allocation, invocation and the surrounding block
change the measured result; random-weight output agreement establishes neither
task accuracy nor whole-network speed.
[Matched module analysis](results/rtx4090/session-20260908-vast-03/analysis-supplemental/summary.zh-CN.md).

> N=4模块保留了图内收益，同步调用却更慢。N=1的Graph比值为1.04879，判为TIE；API为0.66465，判为LOSS。分配、调用与模块周边工作都会影响结果，因此要分别测量，不能从单个内核直接推算应用延迟。随机权重输出一致也不证明任务准确率或整网提速。[配对模块分析](results/rtx4090/session-20260908-vast-03/analysis-supplemental/summary.zh-CN.md)。

## k1 相对 k0：空间映射与专用几何

直接观测：k1 在全部 8 点均比 k0 短，描述加速约 1.359–3.323 倍。前五个小/中规模点的 DRAM 合计差异通常只有数千字节，62e0 大点甚至由 174,502,784 B 增至 175,534,720 B；同时 k1 的 L2 sectors 在全部八点均高于 k0。因此这批结果不支持“k1 主要因减少 DRAM/L2 总流量而变快”的叙述。

代码支持的解释：k0 每线程通过输出扁平索引恢复坐标，接受通用核/步长/膨胀参数；k1 将 block 映射为 16×8 空间 tile，固定 3×3、步长1、padding1几何，保留相同 NCHW 和逐输出归约。减少通用索引处理及改变线程映射是合理机制候选。但两项同时改变，这不是仅修改 coalescing 的单因素实验；具体指令减少、调度和地址合并贡献尚待 .so SASS 核验。

## k2 相对 k1：shared halo 不是普遍获益

直接观测：六个支持点中，k2 仅在 053183、866edd 两点比 k1 短（25.568→21.760 μs；40.640→33.344 μs）；78e99、ccafda、89f791、62e0 四点均更长。f49992、8a8acc 因 CPG 契约不支持，不能算性能失败。

k2 的 DRAM bytes 没有相应的大幅下降，L2 sectors 也并非一致减少。已采集细节的三个支持点中，shared-load bank conflicts 分别是 0、64,512、774,144；local load/store sectors 均为 0。不能用后四点未采集的 conflict/issue/eligible 数据补足因果链。尤其 62e0 的 active-warps 指标达到 98.35%，仍慢于 k1 的 80.80% 对应结果；高 occupancy 不是时间更短的充分条件。

代码支持的解释：k2 使用 CPG×10×18 的共享 halo，每块协作加载，并在每个 tile 前后各有一次 barrier；CPG1/2/4 编译期归约展开。输入复用有潜在收益，同时付出共享访问、边缘加载和同步成本。上述冲突计数与“共享访问并非免费”一致，但既没有足够 stall 分解，也没有一次只移除 barrier/改变bank布局的对照，不能把具体慢幅归因于冲突或同步。展开和协作加载同时改变，也不是纯粹缓存复用实验。

## k3：四输出寄存器复用的收益与小点例外

直接观测：k3 在七个点比 k1 短，唯独最小 78e99 点为 3.008 μs，慢于 k1 的 2.496 μs，且其 DRAM 82,432 B/L2 13,201 sectors 均高于 k1 的 71,424 B/10,376 sectors。其他七点的 L2 sectors 均低于 k1；多数点 DRAM 差异仍很小，62e0 由 175,534,720 B 降至 173,007,104 B。

除最小点外的三个已采集细节点中，k3 尽管 active-warps、eligible-warps 与 issue-active 指标低于 k1，时间仍较短；例如 89f791 的 18.784→11.296 μs，active-warps 72.38%→51.86%，issue-active 73.36%→47.07%。这说明这些比例指标不能脱离工作量和持续时间单独排名。

代码支持的解释：每线程处理横向四输出，六元素输入行与同一权重在四个累加器间复用；没有共享内存或 barrier。更少重复请求、更少输出线程和更高每线程工作量均可解释观察；小点并行度下降、边缘无效输出计算或固定成本可能压过复用收益。此处只是候选机制，不能由单次采集确认哪一项占主导。已采集的四个细节点全部实现 local load/store sectors 为零，只能说这些采集未观察到 local traffic；不能据此宣称所有点都无 spill。

## 尚不能确定

DRAM bytes 是当前采集的硬件流量，不是源代码逻辑访存量；write-back/cache状态可影响边界。sector 数量没有被换算为字节。注册数与 occupancy-limit 指标在 analysis.json 中列为 unavailable，本稿不从额外 CSV列自行补数。active-warps 是观测比例，不等于完整的硬件资源占用上限诊断。

已核对完整静态包的 267 个命令及输出哈希、115 个输入二进制哈希。31 份本轮 profile 和 2 份 micro report 重新导出的 CSV 均与原 CSV 逐字节一致。实际 libgroupconv.so SHA 与本轮 profile 的 library_sha256 相同；本次反汇编明确针对 sm_89。详见 static-audit.json。

| 实现 | 硬件寄存器 | 静态共享内存 B | STACK/LOCAL B | 静态 FFMA 条数 | 静态 BAR 条数 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: |
| k0 naive | 64 | 0 | 0/0 | 7 | 0 |
| k1 spatial | 46 | 0 | 0/0 | 9 | 0 |
| k2 CPG1 | 40 | 720 | 0/0 | 9 | 2 |
| k2 CPG2 | 40 | 1440 | 0/0 | 18 | 2 |
| k2 CPG4 | 40 | 2880 | 0/0 | 36 | 2 |
| k3 register_outputs | 64 | 0 | 0/0 | 36 | 0 |

这些条数是反汇编文本中的指令位置数量，不能当作每线程或整个 kernel 的动态执行次数。循环、分支和 predication 决定实际工作量；尤其 k0 的 7 个静态 FFMA 位置不等于每输出只做 7 次 FMA，k3 的多个 STG 位置也不是每线程固定写 16 个输出。

k2 三个实例均保留 LDS、STS 与两处 BAR，CPG×720 B 与源码 halo 数组对应，归约展开的 FFMA 数为 CPG×9。k1 有 9 个 FFMA 位置并保留全局读取，支持专用 3×3 归约的机器码观察。k3 保留 36 个 FFMA 位置，全局读写存在，未见共享访问或 BAR；这与四输出寄存器复用设计一致。k3 分配 64 个寄存器，高于 k1 的 46 个，与资源压力差异假设相容，但仍不能单独解释各点时间或 occupancy 的变化。

六个 kernel 的资源记录均为零 STACK/LOCAL，静态 SASS 未见 LDL/STL。此结论针对这份二进制，结合已采集四个细节点零 local sectors，可收窄 spill 假设；不把零 local traffic 当作所有性能原因已排除。实际机器码即便有 --fmad false 编译标记仍保留显式 FFMA，符合源码使用显式 fmaf 的事实。

静态核验提高了代码到二进制结构的一致性；重复导出提高了报告到 CSV 的可复现性。它们都不独立证明 GPU launch 的执行真实性、排他性或优化生效的唯一因果，前述单次 profile 条件限制仍然适用。

`source path → site target → SHA-256 → generating command`, and the ten per-page digits audits
under [`docs/evidence/`](docs/evidence/) (`digits-*.md`), which list each visible number's file,
JSON path, and hash. The scripts below are the receipts — each one fails the build rather than
let a claim drift.

## Stack · 技术栈

Next.js 16 App Router with static generation, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS 4;
Playwright drives the browser gates. Fonts are self-hosted — IBM Plex Latin subsets plus a
Chinese serif subset generated by [`scripts/subset-zh-serif.mjs`](scripts/subset-zh-serif.mjs).
The heavy in-browser engines — DuckDB-WASM for SQL over parquet, onnxruntime-web for in-tab
inference, Tesseract.js for OCR — never load with the page: each sits behind an explicit click
that advertises its ledger-checked size first (the DuckDB engine is 39,362,651 bytes, shared by
the three data routes; the triage int8 model is 67,575,183 bytes).

> 前端是 Next.js 16 App Router 静态生成 + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 4，浏览器门禁由 Playwright 驱动。字体全部自托管：IBM Plex 拉丁子集，加上由 [`scripts/subset-zh-serif.mjs`](scripts/subset-zh-serif.mjs) 生成的中文衬线子集。DuckDB-WASM（SQL over parquet）、onnxruntime-web（页内推理）、Tesseract.js（OCR）这类重引擎一律不随页面加载：每一个都藏在明确的点击之后，点击前先按账本核对过的体积明示——DuckDB 引擎 39,362,651 字节，由三条数据路由共用；triage int8 模型 67,575,183 字节。

## 技术栈

Next.js 16 App Router 静态生成 + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 4，浏览器门禁由 Playwright
驱动。字体全部自托管：IBM Plex 拉丁子集，加上由
[`scripts/subset-zh-serif.mjs`](scripts/subset-zh-serif.mjs) 生成的中文衬线子集。浏览器内重引擎
（DuckDB-WASM 查询、onnxruntime-web 推理、Tesseract.js OCR）一律不随页面加载：先明示与账本核对过的
体积（DuckDB 引擎 39,362,651 字节，由三条数据路由共用；triage int8 模型 67,575,183 字节），点击后才下载。
